test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Lift the veil!

options.text: Let the veil had been lifted!
Please let the veil be lifted now!
Let the veil have been lifted!

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The imperative sentence **"Lift the veil!" **is being converted into its passive form.
 
• In** passive voice**, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The correct passive form should be **"Let the veil be lifted!"**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** ***"Let the veil be lifted!"***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Let the veil had been lifted!"** – Incorrect because "had been" is not used in imperative sentences.
 
• **Option 2: "Please let the veil be lifted now!"** – Incorrect because "please" and "now" change the sentence structure and meaning.
 
• **Option 4: "Let the veil have been lifted!"** – Incorrect because "have been" is not appropriate for an imperative sentence.
